script.title: AT THE REGISTRATION TABLE
script.scene_zh: 社區中心 · 選民登記
script.story_hook: A new citizen registers to vote, just in time.
script.intro_zh: 一位新加入國籍的長者,在截止日前完成選民登記。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: signing up to vote at a town table.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學在社區攤位登記投票。
script.outro: Sixty lines later, registration forms hold no surprises.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,登記表格再也不會嚇到你。
script.practice_intro_en: Ready? Say every line aloud with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好了嗎?每句話都跟著大聲唸。
script.char_a_description: a grandmother in her sixties with wavy gray hair in a low bun, wearing a rose-pink cardigan over a cream blouse, dark slacks and comfortable flat shoes, short and round build, holding a small handbag
script.char_b_description: a college-age young man with short curly auburn hair and a round face, wearing a bright yellow volunteer T-shirt with a name tag, blue jeans and green sneakers, lanky build, holding a clipboard

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, what's this table for?
dialogue.zh: 請問,這張桌子是在做什麼的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Voter registration! Are you a citizen?
dialogue.zh: 選民登記!請問您是公民嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, since two thousand eight.
dialogue.zh: 是的,從兩千零八年起就是了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Have you registered before?
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。您以前登記過嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No… do I need much English?
dialogue.zh: 沒有……登記需要很好的英文嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all — it takes five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ət ɔl ɪt teɪks faɪv ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 完全不用,五分鐘就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. What do I bring you?
dialogue.zh: 那正好。我需要提供什麼給您?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your name, birth date, and address.
dialogue.zh: 您的姓名、出生年月日和住址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's easy. My name is Mei Lin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈizi maɪ neɪm ɪz meɪ lɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這簡單,我叫梅琳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the street with your apartment?
dialogue.zh: 您住的公寓在哪條街呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maple Street, number four-oh-two.
dialogue.zh: 楓樹街,四〇二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you have an ID number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt du ju hæv ən aɪˈdi ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。您有身分證字號嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um… my driver's license expired.
dialogue.zh: 呃……我的駕照過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Last four of your social card?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm læst fɔr əv jɔr ˈsoʊʃəl kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題,那社保卡最後四碼也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me find my glasses… here.
dialogue.zh: 讓我找一下老花眼鏡……找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead — I'll write as you read.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd aɪl raɪt æz ju rid/
dialogue.zh: 請唸給我,我邊聽邊寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five, seven, one, nine — please read it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈsɛvən wʌn naɪn pliz rid ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 五、七、一、九——請唸回來給我核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course — five, seven, one, nine.
dialogue.zh: 當然——五、七、一、九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's it. You're very careful.
dialogue.zh: 對了。你做事真仔細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For votes, careful is good.
dialogue.zh: 關於投票,仔細點總沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very true. What's next?
dialogue.zh: 說得是。接下來呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small thing — the party line.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個小欄位——政黨的類別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Party? Like cake and balloons?
dialogue.zh: 派對?就是蛋糕和氣球那種?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! No, a voting group.
dialogue.zh: 哈!不是,是指投票的政黨團體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. Can I skip that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ aɪ si kæn aɪ skɪp ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 噢,懂了。那一欄可以不填嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure — write none, no preference.
dialogue.zh: 可以——寫無,沒有偏好就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then none, please. I like candidates, not groups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn nʌn pliz aɪ laɪk ˈkændəˌdeɪts nɑt ɡrupz/
dialogue.zh: 那就填無。我喜歡看候選人,不看黨派。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice way to choose. Email for confirmation?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs weɪ tə tʃuz ˈiməl fər ˌkɑnˌfɜrˈmeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 這選擇方式真好。留個信箱收確認信?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son set one up for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn sɛt wʌn ʌp fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子幫我設了一個電子信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great — can you spell it slowly?
dialogue.zh: 好,可以慢慢拼給我看嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure: m-e-i-l-i-n-z-e-r-o.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɛm i ɛl aɪ ɛn zi i ɑr oʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好:m-e-i-l-i-n-z-e-r-o。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Typed. Do you see it on paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪpt du ju si ɪt ɑn ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 打好了,你要在紙上核對一下嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes… that's exactly right.
dialogue.zh: 好……完全正確。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, one signature and you're done.
dialogue.zh: 再簽個名,就搞定啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign right where the X is?
dialogue.zh: 簽在畫X的地方嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly there. Beautiful signature.
dialogue.zh: 就那裡。您的字好漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Now my husband — can he register too?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ naʊ maɪ ˈhʌzbənd kæn hi ˈrɛdʒəstə/
dialogue.zh: 哈!那我先生呢,他也能登記嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does he have his citizenship papers?
dialogue.zh: 他有公民身份的證書嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only his green card… hmm.
dialogue.zh: 他只有綠卡……嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then not yet — citizens only, I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn nɑt jɛt ˈsɪtəmənz ˈoʊnli aɪm ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 那暫時不行,只能公民登記,不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Maybe after his next test.
dialogue.zh: 好,也許等他下次考完試就能。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When he's a citizen, absolutely.
dialogue.zh: 等他拿到公民身份,一定可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. What happens now, for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ wʌt ˈhæpənz naʊ fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 知道就好。那我接下來會怎樣?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch your mail — a sample ballot comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ jɔr meɪl ə ˈsæmˌpəl ˈbælət kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 留意信箱——會寄來一張模擬選票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ballot? Like… a practice vote?
dialogue.zh: 選票?就像……練習投票那樣的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! It lists everyone running.
dialogue.zh: 對!上面列出所有參選的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that helps a lot at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ ðæt hɛlpz ə lɑt æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 噢,那在家研究就方便多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And voting day is November third.
dialogue.zh: 投票日是十一月三日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I vote in person, or by mail?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ voʊt ɪn ˈpɜrsən ɔr baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我要親自去投,還是用寄的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either works — the mail form is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːðər wərks ðə meɪl fɔrm ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 兩種都行,寄票的表格是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — this wasn't too late?
dialogue.zh: 等等——我這樣不算是來晚了吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made it — it's four fifty.
dialogue.zh: 趕上了——現在四點五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table closes at five?
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子五點收,對吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does. Ten minutes to spare!
dialogue.zh: 是呀,你還多十分鐘的空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. Close one, but happy.
dialogue.zh: 呼,好驚險,但很快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your sticker — I registered!
dialogue.zh: 給您這張貼紙——我已登記!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How cute! I'll wear it proudly.
dialogue.zh: 真可愛!我要很驕傲地戴著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. Your polling place is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du jɔr ˈpoʊlɪŋ pleɪs ɪz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 儘管戴。您投票的場所就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even better. Thank you, my friend.
dialogue.zh: 那就更方便了。謝謝你,朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you — every voice matters.
dialogue.zh: 該謝謝您的是我——每一票都重要。

script.youtube_description_en:
"Party? Like cake and balloons?" — the sweetest misunderstanding at the registration table. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a brand-new citizen sits down with a cheerful volunteer to register to vote: giving her name, street and apartment, using the last four digits of her social card after her license expired, choosing no party preference, spelling her email slowly, signing just in time before the table closes at five. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Warm, funny, and packed with real form-filling English. No memorizing — just listen often. Designed for A2 learners. Subscribe and tap the bell for a new immersive English listening animation every week!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
